name: 38002 · Arlington, TN
findings: ZIP 38002 (Arlington) has 128 nonprofit organizations. 52 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 36 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 38002 (Arlington) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 38002 (Arlington) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 52% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 69 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.
